effects.label: Action
effects.text: Reveal the opponent's Hand. Choose one eligible Gambit there. Until the end of the turn, if they set a Gambit in a battle involving you, they must set that card if able.

effects.label: Tactic
effects.text: After Tactics are chosen, before they are normally revealed, reveal this card if it is face down. Reveal one opposing face-down Tactic. You may return this card to your Reserve and choose another eligible Tactic from your Reserve face down.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Spend any amount of Conviction. Put that many cards from the top of the opponent's Draw Pile in their Graveyard.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: After Tactics are revealed, spend any amount of Conviction. For each Conviction spent, choose one: add +1 to your battle total; or, if you win, put the top card of the opponent's Draw Pile in their Graveyard in the Aftermath. You may choose either option more than once.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: You may spend 4 Conviction to apply the Battle effect of one card in the opponent's Graveyard that can apply now. Leave that card in the opponent's Graveyard.

effects.label: Aftermath
effects.text: When you lose a battle while this card is in your Hand, in the Aftermath before battle cards are cleared, you may play it without taking an Action. If you do, cards remaining in the opponent's Reserve go to their Graveyard instead of their Discard Pile in this Aftermath. After battle cards are cleared, set your Conviction to 4 and put this card in your Graveyard. This card does not prevent the loss, retreat, Occupation, or other normal consequences of the battle result.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: After Tactics are revealed in a battle involving you, before dice are rolled, you may discard this card. If the opponent loses, they cannot benefit from effects they control triggered by that loss or resulting retreat, and they retreat one additional position.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: If the opponent loses, they cannot benefit from effects they control triggered by that loss or resulting retreat, and they retreat one additional position.
